# beatLabs

> Dubai-based design lab (BeatLabs FZE LLC): ideas turned into apps, websites and brands — each with its own name, domain, and identity.

beatLabs designs and builds its own apps and runs two studios for client work (brand, web and photography). Everything starts as an idea in the lab; each product then gets its own identity, audience, and business model.

## Apps

- [Nibango](https://nibango.com) — Local marketplace to buy, sell, bid and give away near you. Six categories with their own filters (including pay for jobs), four ways to deal, offers and counter-offers, nearby places in the chat, moderated groups for your area or your interests, zero commission. iPhone, Android and web (nibango.com) in 17 languages. Live. Landing page in 17 languages: https://beatlabs.ae/nibango
- [Curb](https://getcurbapp.com) — Tracks subscriptions, installment plans and prepaid passes on iOS and Android, in 13 languages. Several reminders per subscription, add by voice with Siri on iPhone. No bank access, 33 currencies, one-time Pro purchase. Live.
- [Raved](https://raved.app) — An inbox for recommendations: save every film, show, book, album, podcast and place your friends rave about, with a Home Screen widget and an optional reminder. iOS and Android, in 6 languages. Live.
- [Blab](https://blab.day) — A small social network for saying what you think, in 28 worlds of people who share your interests, with one optional daily challenge; answers carry up to 4 photos or videos, up to 3 stickers, polls, Check-ins or a workout from Apple Health / Health Connect with a weekly ranking; every 3 friends you invite who start posting earn you a month of Pro. iOS, Android and web (blab.day), in 13 languages. Live.

## Web & Creative

- [True Love Creative](https://truelovecreative.es) — Creative studio in Dubai: web design, brand identity, graphic design and app development since 2015.
- [Estrela.photo](https://estrela.photo) — Photographer for artists, DJs and performers in Dubai.
